name: Swarm of Lesser Strix
biography: Statistics of a swarm of ravens (Monster Manual), but vulnerable to fire. Each lesser strix is an artificial crow of burlap, straw, twigs and sharp stone teeth. Source: Arc C, C3. Arc balancing for 3 players: 16 HP, Beaks 5 (2d4), or 2 (1d4) at half HP or fewer.

items.name: Swarm
items.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny strix. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

items.name: Beaks
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage, or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
